raw.title: v0.2.1
raw.body:
## What's New

### MCP Server: New AI Agent Tools
- **`generate_workflow`** — Generate Arazzo workflow YAML from natural language descriptions
- **`describe_openapi`** — Summarize an OpenAPI spec's endpoints, schemas, and auth for AI consumption
- **`generate_example`** — Produce realistic example values for OpenAPI request/response schemas

### Improved Example Generation
- Better OpenAPI example value generation with realistic data for common field patterns

### New `arazzo-generate` Crate
- Extracted generation logic into its own workspace crate (`arazzo-generate`), decoupling it from the CLI binary

### Performance
- 6–38% faster expression evaluation via `Cow<str>`, `&'static str` operator returns, and `Arc`-wrapped step outputs
- Eliminated O(n²) BTreeMap cloning in workflow output building
- Replaced O(n×m) parameter merge with O(n+m) HashSet dedup
- Zero-copy ID validation in the spec validator

### Security
- Upgraded `rustls-webpki` to 0.103.10 (RUSTSEC-2026-0049)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/strefethen/arazzo-cli/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
